_comment: Debug input for the 'debug: measure boxes' screen. Coordinates are PIXELS of your loaded image (NOT 0..1): x,y = top-left corner; w,h = size. Read them from an image editor (Paint/GIMP/Preview) and adjust to YOUR image's resolution. The values below are an example for a ~1280x720 image. Roles: main_text (letter+bg), serve, prev_set_win, prev_set_lose, current_set (digit+cell bg), current_game (digit+cell bg).
